brief.subject: A miniature team workspace with four functional zones: a planning board, two execution desks, a tracking board and a review meeting table. Seven expressive adult professionals interact in small groups.
brief.action: Two people arrange planning cards, two work at computers, one checks a progress board and two discuss the next cycle at a meeting table.
brief.structure: Four distinct work areas share one raised rectangular mineral base, linked by modest floor paths in the actual order planning, execution, tracking and review.
brief.details: Light oak desks, graphite frames, woven blue and sage chairs, unmarked task cards and detailed human faces. Sparse geometric boards, no raster labels or floating icon.
brief.composition: 16:9 landscape, 40-degree elevated near-orthographic view, complete mineral-composite base and contact shadow inside modest margins. Tactile realistic materials and expressive stylized adults; no text anywhere.

slides.subtitle: 围绕同一份交付物核对进展、问题和责任

items.title: 看懂当前进展
items.text: 让团队围绕同一份进度记录沟通。

items.title: 确认下一步动作
items.text: 交接材料，同时说明责任与完成条件。

items.title: 保留复盘依据
items.text: 把结论与行动项关联，便于下次回看。

visual.rationale: 同层级条目保持无框对齐；交接动作的标题和图标略放大，配图展示真实协作。

image.alt: 三位同事围绕会议桌、文件夹和进度白板进行交接

brief.subject: Three expressive miniature professionals in a project handoff meeting around one oak table, with a moderately sized rolling progress board and three upholstered chairs.
brief.action: Two seated colleagues pass an unmarked ochre folder while a standing colleague points to a geometric progress chart.
brief.structure: The table is the shared handoff point; the board is a secondary context object behind the group, with a clear triangular arrangement and open sightlines.
brief.details: Stone-composite base, graphite document shelf, soft blue woven chairs, an unlettered laptop, clean folder surfaces and detailed natural hands and faces.
brief.composition: 16:9 landscape, 40-degree elevated near-orthographic view, complete mineral-composite base and contact shadow inside modest margins. Tactile realistic materials and expressive stylized adults; no text anywhere.

brief.subject: A compact miniature review area with three colleagues, a small oak meeting table, a document folder and a quiet geometric whiteboard behind the table.
brief.action: The team closes the review discussion by handing the agreed action folder to the next responsible colleague.
brief.structure: One shared table and an unobstructed handoff connect the participants; the low shelf and board remain subordinate, without additional workflow zones.
brief.details: Matte graphite furniture legs, subtle wood grain, a sage fabric rug, one small laptop and carefully modeled adult expressions; paper and device surfaces remain unlettered.
